name: ThermaFreeze Products Corporation
summary: ThermaFreeze Products Corporation is a company dedicated to manufacturing and supplying hydratable ice sheets. Its flagship product, ThermaFreeze, is a highly versatile and reusable ice solution, alongside an expanded product line that includes industrial gel pack rolls, 1-ounce and 4-ounce gel pack cubes, specialized Therma-wraps with accompanying accessories, and retail-ready packaged products. These innovative cooling solutions serve a broad spectrum of applications, from perishable goods shipping and sports therapy to personal use, outdoor recreation, medical requirements, and equestrian needs. Established in 1968, ThermaFreeze Products Corporation is headquartered in Theodore, Alabama.
